items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch of the gated product; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: API access is documented, but rights to store, transform, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; current public terms point against the proposed use. Security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, measurement, and launch gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical evidence only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Do not send outreach, expand alerts, deploy, change configuration, monetize, or claim launch clearance.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence includes official API documentation and terms, backend and configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted caching and display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked and counsel_required for public display, derivatives, alerts, affiliate use, and advertising. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator and vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Fleet triage: incomplete telemetry alone is not a general launch blocker, and ordinary reversible growth may proceed conditionally where site-specific consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are evidenced. Do not add tracking, expand monetization, publish new claims, or expand affiliate use on failed or unknown sites until applicable evidence is available. The current compliance baseline records 16 failed and 6 unknown sites; analytics and revenue attribution are yellow; aggregate revenue must remain unattributed; and no new production proposal is supported this cycle.
